releases.name: Neon Cruisers
releases.summary: A stunt-focused neon arcade racer where speed is your health. Flip, spin, loop and corkscrew off ramps to keep your FLOW burning, wreck rivals into neon shards, and be the last one standing across 20 synthwave stages.

releases.name: Frogborne: New Lands
releases.summary: A colorful adventure awaits!

releases.name: Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark

releases.summary: First-person psychological horror set in an abandoned school. Explore eerie environments, collect keys and hidden clues to piece together your past and uncover the truth behind the ghost that haunts you.

releases.name: KLAST
releases.summary: KLAST is a fast twin-stick bullet-hell roguelite where every run transforms your ship. Chain kills, rescue survivors, collect powerful upgrades, and conquer three distinct campaigns filled with shifting arenas, relentless swarms, and colossal guardians.

releases.name: Windward Isles
releases.summary: Trade, fight, and sail beyond the chart in a sun-drenched age-of-sail sandbox. Run cargo across ten living harbours, outgun corsairs with thundering broadsides, and rise from deckhand to legend — from a nimble cutter to a mighty man-o'-war.

releases.name: Numble
releases.summary: Numble takes the classic concept of Wordle and gives it a twist. This time it’s not about letters, but about cracking secret number codes.

releases.name: The Tower Of The Mad Wizard
releases.summary: A first-person horror adventure with action and puzzle elements. Exploration is irremissible. Death is foretold.

releases.name: Mother;Above
releases.summary: 48 hours before the floodgates open and drown the town to protect the City Above. Vik and his friends steal a maintenance tram through the wall. A short psychological horror VN about escape made useful.

releases.name: Delivery Simulator
releases.summary:
Parcels don’t deliver themselves, and the city won’t make things easy for you. Take the wheel and face the intense daily grind of a delivery driver, navigating busy streets, tight shortcuts, and surprises at every corner. Collect orders, load the cargo, and plan the best route to arrive on time.

Unlock achievements by completing special objectives, beating the clock without crashing your car, and maintaining delivery streaks with no delays. More challenges mean more reasons to improve with every run!

The goal is simple: deliver as much as possible, earn rewards, buy a variety of insane vehicles, and upgrade your operation to become a true reference in the city. Because here, every second counts and every delivery makes a difference!

releases.name: Land of Winds
releases.summary: This game is a fantasy style cultivation+MMORPG game, focusing on character development, pet matching, and guild territory confrontation. Players use forging and upgrading as the core growth line to participate in guild territory wars and win the title of king.

releases.name: Dirtnap
releases.summary: Dig, fly and fight through fully destructible maps in multiple game modes. Every character has its own unique ability, every biome its own hazards, and the weapon arsenal runs from machine guns to banana bombs to airstrikes. Play with friends, strangers, bots, or all of them.

releases.name: Garden of Witches
releases.summary: Garden of Witches is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.

releases.name: Salt & Schooners
releases.summary: Washed ashore in 1789 on a chain of over 30 Pacific islands. Forage, hunt, build a fragile boat, and risk every journey as it constantly falls apart. Explore caves, shipwrecks, and underwater loot. Trade, fight tribes, and try to reach civilisation.. but nothing is free other than this game..

releases.name: Package chaos
releases.summary: Package Chaos is a cozy package sorting game where you turn a messy warehouse into a perfectly organized delivery center.Pick up, inspect, sort thousands of unique packages and enjoy the satisfying feeling of a perfectly organized warehouse.

releases.name: Solve The Puzzle
releases.summary: Solve The Puzzle - is a puzzle game that has up to 10 different levels to play. This is a single player game, the player reads the goal at the start of each level and tries to put the shapes at a specific state or position to achieve it.

releases.name: Devil Worm
releases.summary: Arcade style 3d worm adventure game where mission is to eat material and get snake bigger and also collect bottles.

releases.name: Unicycle Journey
releases.summary: Ride a unicycle through colorful obstacle courses. Overcome tricky challenges and chase the circus before it's too late.

releases.name: Age of the Fallen
releases.summary: Fight endless hordes in this fast-paced dark fantasy Bullet Heaven. Choose from 10 heroes, collect 500+ cards, unlock devastating evolutions and create 128M+ combos—alone or in local co-op with a friend.

releases.name: Venture Capital Tycoon
releases.summary: Run your own venture capital firm. Hunt deals, research founders, write the checks — then live with the results. Most bets fail. The one that doesn't pays for everything: a bigger fund, the corner office, a name every founder knows. Outrank the big firms, or take yours public.

releases.name: Mangata
releases.summary: **Mangata** is a story-driven 2D pixel art platformer where mystery, exploration, and emotion come together. Step into Stephan's journey, overcome challenging environments, and uncover a truth hidden beyond what appears to be reality.
